en_US.title: Native Sulfide Salt Stack
en_US.scanner: Natural resource. Useful, corrosive, older than Deep Reach.
en_US.field_note: Not every resource should be spooky. Some are just geology that can still kill you.
en_US.terminal: RESOURCE CLASS: native. Sulfide salts, metal ions, brine crusts. Uses: conductor wash, corrosion catalysts, ceramic flux, battery emergency chemistry.
en_US.audio: The moon was valuable before anyone taught it to be monstrous.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Native sulfide salts are baseline HECTON-8 geology. They support batteries, ceramics, conductor cleaning and corrosive hazards. They should appear before blue debt so the player learns that the moon has real chemistry, not only corporate horror material.
en_US.external_site: Native Sulfide Salt Stack defines the natural resource layer of HECTON-8: dangerous, useful and independent of Deep Reach intent.
